data.one_liner: Plugin to create and manage background download tasks on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It schedules downloads using WorkManager on Android and NSURLSessionDownloadTask on iOS, supports concurrent tasks, notifications, and optional HTTP configuration. Files are saved to external storage on Android and the Documents directory on iOS.
use_when: You need reliable background downloads on mobile devices
You want to limit concurrent downloads and get system notifications
avoid_when: You require cross‑platform download support for web or desktop
You need fine‑grained download control beyond what WorkManager provides
strengths: Runs downloads in background even when app is closed
Handles iOS and Android native download APIs
weaknesses: Requires native setup on both platforms
Limited to Android and iOS only
Past versions had SQL injection vulnerabilities
data.setup_notes: iOS: enable background mode, add sqlite library, configure AppDelegate. Android: add provider entry in AndroidManifest, ensure external storage permission. May need to adjust Info.plist for ATS or concurrent task limits.
